form.label: Rule Reference
form.description: What a rule looks for, how it runs here, and why it is trusted as much as it is. Pick a rule to read it.

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv | search $plat$ $find$ | eval label = sigma_rule." — ".sigma_level | sort label | head 500 | table label, sigma_rule_id

| inputlookup sigma_rules.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | lookup sigma_rule_logic sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_description | eval "Rule"=sigma_rule, "What it is for"=if(sigma_description="","no description in the rule",sigma_description), "Platform"=sigma_platform, "Log source"=sigma_log_source, "Severity"=sigma_level, "Confidence"=sigma_confidence." (".sigma_confidence_score."/100)", "Handling"=if(sigma_disposition="immediate", "Alerts on a single match — severe and specific enough to trust.", "Recorded and baselined. Its value is the pattern, not one occurrence."), "Matches needed before it records"=sigma_min_matches, "Sigma status"=if(sigma_status="","not stated",sigma_status) | fields "Rule","What it is for","Platform","Log source","Severity", "Confidence","Handling","Matches needed before it records","Sigma status" | transpose column_name="." | rename "row 1" as " "

panel.title: The ATT&CK technique it maps to

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | lookup mitre_techniques technique_id as sigma_technique OUTPUT display_name, url, description, detection, data_sources, tactic_names | eval "Technique"=if(isnull(display_name),"This rule carries no ATT&CK mapping.", display_name." (".sigma_technique.")"), "Tactic"=coalesce(tactic_names,"unmapped"), "What the technique is"=coalesce(description,"no description available"), "Telemetry ATT&CK expects"=coalesce(data_sources,"not stated"), "How ATT&CK suggests detecting it"=coalesce(detection,"not stated"), "Read more"=coalesce(url,"https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/enterprise/") | fields "Technique","Tactic","What the technique is","Telemetry ATT&CK expects", "How ATT&CK suggests detecting it","Read more" | transpose column_name="." | rename "row 1" as " "

panel.title: What it looks for — the author's own detection block, unchanged

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rule_logic.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | eval line=split(sigma_detection_yaml," ") | mvexpand line | where line!="" | streamstats count as n | table n, line | rename n as "#", line as "Sigma detection"

| inputlookup sigma_rules.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | lookup sigma_rule_logic sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_condition, sigma_spl, sigma_scope | eval "Sigma condition"=coalesce(sigma_condition,"unavailable"), "Scope it searches"=if(sigma_scope="","the whole index — no log source mapping",sigma_scope), "As SPL"=coalesce(sigma_spl,"unavailable"), "Evaluated by"=sigma_batch | fields "Sigma condition","Scope it searches","As SPL","Evaluated by" | transpose column_name="." | rename "row 1" as " "

panel.title: Why it is trusted this much

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rule_logic.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | eval reason=split(sigma_confidence_why," | ") | mvexpand reason | where reason!="" | table reason | rename reason as "What the scoring took into account"

panel.title: What the author says gets this wrong

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | eval fp=if(sigma_falsepositives="" OR sigma_falsepositives="Unknown", "The author declared none, or stated them as unknown. That is not the same as there being none.", sigma_falsepositives) | eval item=split(fp,", ") | mvexpand item | table item | rename item as "Known false positives"

panel.title: Sources — where this rule came from

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | eval ref=split(sigma_references,", ") | mvexpand ref | eval ref=if(ref="","the rule cites no references",ref) | table ref | rename ref as "Reference" | append [ | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | eval "Reference"="The rule file: ".sigma_source_url | fields "Reference" ] | append [ | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv where sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | eval "Reference"="Author: ".if(sigma_author="","not stated",sigma_author) ." · last modified ".if(sigma_rule_date="","unknown",sigma_rule_date) ." · id ".sigma_rule_id | fields "Reference" ]

index=sigma_alerts sigma_rule_id="$rule_id|s$" | eval when=strftime(sigma_first_seen,"%F %T") | table when, sigma_src_host, sigma_match_count, sigma_src_sourcetype | rename when as "First seen", sigma_src_host as "Host", sigma_match_count as "Events", sigma_src_sourcetype as "Source type" | sort - "First seen"
